title: unmapped XSUAA identity is denied safely
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / AppRouter / XSUAA / HANA Cloud
testCommand: Read-only BTP user-role inventory plus User Administration identity-link readback
actualResult: Blocked by a missing required fixture: every available SAP identity in the target subaccount is already mapped to an active IDTS user. Reusing a mapped identity would not execute the unmapped-identity branch, and creating or unlinking a real identity was outside the approved scope.
assertions: Cloud Foundry and BTP sessions were available.
All six available SAP identities were mapped to active IDTS users.
No unmapped identity fixture was available.
No user, identity link, role, or HANA row was created or removed for this case.
No product failure or PASS was claimed.
limitations: To execute this case later, provide one authorized SAP identity with an IDTS role collection but no active IDTS Users mapping. Do not unlink an existing project member solely to satisfy the test.
